name: Stained Lace
source:
A maid who is struggling through life happens upon a job that might allow a brief reprieve from her troubled past. But it may also define her future.

[From [url=https://sarlianna.itch.io/stained-lace]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位在生活中挣扎的女佣偶然找到了一份工作，可以让她暂时摆脱过去的麻烦。但这也可能决定她的未来。

[来自[url=https://sarlianna.itch.io/stained-lace]itch.io[/url]]
